summary: Well-structured Pester test suite with good separation of concerns across 7 focused test files covering version parsing, commit analysis, version bumping, changelog generation, and CI/CD integration via act. Comprehensive coverage of main requirements including unit tests, integration tests, and workflow validation. However, rigor is limited by gaps in edge-case coverage (pre-release versions, boundary values like 0.0.0 or 999.x.x, special characters in commit messages, file I/O errors). Test independence is sound (temp directories, proper cleanup), and fixture-based approach is clean, though actual fixture files are not shown in the provided code. The act-integration test harness (Test-WorkflowWithAct.ps1) properly validates CI/CD behavior but depends on exact output format assumptions ("New version: X.Y.Z"). Would catch most regressions on happy-path and common errors but miss subtle boundary cases.
